WELCOME TO MALAIKA SERONERA LUXURY CAMPS IN SERENGETI!
Tanzania at its purest...
In the heart of the Serengeti, Malaika Seronera offers calm luxury, sweeping plains, and an intimate safari atmosphere surrounded by wildlife.
Elegant tents, thoughtful service, and evenings by the fire create a stay that feels both relaxed and unforgettable.
LOCATION
Set in central Serengeti at Warangi 3, Malaika Seronera is about 35 km from Seronera Airstrip, placing guests within easy reach of some of the region s finest game-viewing areas while still preserving a calm, private sense of escape in the heart of the plains.
ACCOMMODATION
The camp includes twelve tented suites with panoramic views, private verandas, and en-suite bathrooms designed for comfort and ease. Two tents connect for families, while the others suit single, double, or triple stays, creating flexible accommodation for couples, friends, and small groups.
Our Accommodation
Spacious safari tents designed for comfort, privacy, and beautiful views across the Serengeti.
LUXURY TENTS
In central Serengeti, our luxury tents bring together comfort, privacy, and close contact with the wild.
Single, Double, and Triple options each include a private ensuite bathroom, warm interiors, and a verandah for sunrise or sunset views.
Every tent is positioned for beautiful views and the quiet sounds of the Serengeti at night.
Single Double Triple
FAMILY LUXURY TENTS
Our family tents combine generous space with comfort, offering a king-size bed and an extra twin bed for families or small groups.
Thoughtful layouts, supportive beds, and a relaxed safari feel make them ideal for longer, easy family stays.

Malaika Safari Camps & Lodges
ABOUT US
Discover our story, values, and commitment to exceptional camp and lodge experiences
Our Story
Malaika Camps & Lodges was born from a love of Africa’s wilderness and a desire to share the beauty of the Serengeti through authentic, comfortable safari stays.
Our name, "Malaika," means "angel" in Swahili and reflects our commitment to caring for this landscape while creating memorable experiences in the wild.
Explore Our Camps
Our Principles
The foundation of our service: offering comfort, luxury, and authenticity at our camps and lodges
01 Sustainability
Conserving nature, promoting eco-friendly practices.
02 Cultural Respect
Honoring traditions, supporting local communities.
03 Exceptional Guest Experiences
Providing luxury, ensuring memorable stays.
04 Environmental Stewardship
Protecting wildlife, preserving natural habitats.
05 Community Engagement
Collaborating locally, fostering mutual benefits.
Malaika Experience
At Malaika, a stay in the wilderness is more than accommodation. It is a chance to connect with nature, culture, and the spirit of the Serengeti in comfort and authenticity.
From golden sunsets to quiet evenings under the stars, every stay is designed to bring you closer to Africa’s landscapes and heritage.
View Our Gallery
Luxury in the Wild
Our accommodations blend naturally with the landscape while offering the comfort, views, and quiet luxury expected from a memorable safari stay.
Wake to the sounds of the bush, enjoy meals under the stars, and unwind in comfort after each day in the wild.
